species.licence: No licence needed from the shore or a jetty. From a powered boat you need a Recreational Fishing from Boat Licence (RFBL).
more: Measure from tip to tip of the side spikes across the widest part of the shell with a proper crab gauge (not a can or ruler). Measure and count each crab as soon as it's in your bag or bucket.

Keep crabs whole until home unless you're eating them straight away. Don't high-grade (swap smaller crabs for bigger ones) — discarded crabs usually die.

DPIRD Rock lobster recreational fishing guide 2026 (July 2026)

species.licence: Recreational rock lobster licence required (from shore or boat).
more: Totally protected: any lobster carrying eggs ("berried"), and western rock lobsters with a tarspot (sperm packet under the body between the back legs) from Windy Harbour to North West Cape. Put them back before you pull the next pot or grab the next lobster.
Night ban south of North West Cape: no pot pulling or diving for lobster 7:30 pm–4:30 am (15 Oct–31 Mar) and 6 pm–6 am (1 Apr–14 Oct).
Divers: by hand, a hand-held snare or a blunt crook only — spears and nets are illegal for lobster. Measure in the water and release undersize ones before taking the next.

Measure the carapace with a gauge: western — from the ridge between the two front horns to the back of the shell; southern — from the notch between the antennae to the back of the shell, along the midline.
Clip or punch the tail fan of every lobster you keep within 5 minutes of landing it (remove at least the lower half of the middle flap, or a 10 mm hole).

Pots: max 2 per licence (6 per boat), 1 entrance, escape gaps (3 between North West Cape and Cape Leeuwin, 1 south and east of Cape Leeuwin), max 2 floats, weighted rope 1 Apr–31 Oct for whales. Never pull someone else's pot.
Release quickly over reef or weed where it was caught — lobsters left out of the water more than 5 minutes sink slowly and get eaten.

No lobster fishing in Rottnest's five conservation areas (Parker Point, Thomson Bay, Armstrong Bay, Green Island, West End) or in marine park sanctuary zones. Report tagged lobsters (tag number, size, sex, place, depth) to DPIRD.
